basic_details.job_title: Patna Civil Court Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 3 Stenographer, Clerk, Peon/Orderly Posts
basic_details.short_information: One post each of Stenographer, Clerk and Peon/Orderly (3 posts in all) is to be filled on a contractual basis in the Evening Court, Patna, and only retired employees of the Civil Courts may apply. Applications must reach the Office of the Principal District & Sessions Judge, Patna on or before 16 December 2026, either personally or through registered post.

content_sections.heading: About Patna Civil Court
content_sections.text: The notice is issued by the Office of the Principal District & Sessions Judge, Patna, Bihar, and invites applications for the engagement of support staff in the Evening Court of the Patna Judgeship. The notice has been forwarded to all Principal District & Sessions Judges of Bihar for publication on the notice boards of their judgeships, and to the Judge-in-Charge, Civil Courts, Patna / Patna City / Danapur / Barh / Masaurhi / Paliganj, and the System Officer, Patna Sadar.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: The application goes to the Office of the Principal District & Sessions Judge, Patna. It can be delivered personally or sent through registered post, and it must reach the office on or before 16 December 2026. The notice does not give a fuller postal address, a prescribed application form or a list of documents to attach.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: The applicant must be a retired employee of the Civil Courts. Only those retired court employees who have retired within the last three years, prior to the period as per guidelines issued by the Hon'ble High Court, Patna, may apply. The applicant must be physically and mentally fit to discharge the duties assigned to the respective post. The applicant must possess satisfactory service records and should not have been subjected to any major disciplinary punishment during service. The official notification does not specify the minimum educational qualification or an age limit for any of the posts. The engagement period, remuneration and other conditions are governed by the applicable rules, guidelines and orders of the competent authority; no pay amount is printed. Candidates should check the official notification for the exact eligibility conditions of each post.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in Patna Civil Court Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 3 posts in the Evening Court, Patna: one Stenographer, one Clerk and one Peon/Orderly.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the Patna Civil Court Evening Court posts?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the Office of the Principal District & Sessions Judge, Patna on or before 16 December 2026.

faq.question: Q3. Who can apply for Patna Civil Court Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Only retired employees of the Civil Courts who retired within the last three years, prior to the period as per guidelines issued by the Hon'ble High Court, Patna, can apply.

faq.question: Q4. What experience is needed for the Stenographer and Clerk posts?
faq.answer: The Stenographer must have the requisite experience and proficiency in shorthand and typing, and the Clerk must have adequate knowledge and experience of clerical and judicial office work.

faq.question: Q5. How do I apply for the Patna Civil Court Evening Court posts?
faq.answer: Submit the application to the Office of the Principal District & Sessions Judge, Patna, either personally or through registered post, so that it reaches by 16 December 2026.

faq.question: Q6. Is the Patna Civil Court Evening Court job permanent?
faq.answer: No. The engagement is purely contractual, can be terminated at any time as per the directions of the Hon'ble High Court Patna, and confers no right to regular appointment or continuation in service.

faq.question: Q7. What are the working hours for the Evening Court posts?
faq.answer: Selected candidates must perform their duties for a minimum of 05 hours on each working day.

faq.question: Q8. Can a retired employee with a major disciplinary punishment apply?
faq.answer: No. The applicant must have satisfactory service records and should not have been subjected to any major disciplinary punishment during service.
